title: 194th Wing Airmen deliver wildfire relief kits
description: U.S. Air Force Master Sgt. Casey Wilson, aerospace medical technician with the 194th Medical Group, Washington Air National Guard, discusses delivering wildfire relief kits to residents impacted by wildfires in Spokane, Wash., Aug. 12, 2026. Wilson and other Washington National Guard members worked alongside the American Red Cross to distribute essential supplies to residents whose homes were damaged or destroyed by wildfires. (U.S. Air National Guard video by Senior Airman Jordaan Kvale)
keywords: Washington Air National Guard, Spokane, Domestic Operations, Wildfire, 194th wing, American Red Cross (ARC)

transcript.text: Most everything that was in the path of
the fire has been completely destroyed .
Driving through these neighborhoods
you'll see complete devastation ,
houses burnt , vehicles burnt , it's
just been eye opening to see what's
been going on here . We have a
distinct mission where we are here to
help the people of Washington state so
if there is a disaster such as
wildfires . It is our privilege and our
honor to go out , wear our uniform ,
and help the communities . Working with
the Red Cross and the Army National
Guard , we've been putting together the
wildfire relief kits which just has
basic necessities to help families that
have lost houses due to the fire .
We've been taking the wildfire relief
kits where houses have been burnt to
the ground and we've been leaving them
with families and if the families
aren't there we've been leaving them by
the houses so when they show up they
have resources to help them . We know
people still have a long way to go and
a long road ahead , but there are other
agencies out there who are here to help
and to be able to reach out to .
